links.outcome: Readability (grade level, ease score) of LLM-generated radiology patient guides
links.effect: ChatGPT had higher grade level (p=0.0482) and word count (p=0.0409) than Gemini; ease score did not differ (p=0.1812). Absolute grade levels were not given in the abstract.
links.quote: However, there is a statistically significant difference, with ChatGPT having a higher word count (p=0.0409) and grade level (p=0.0482) than Google Gemini.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability and reliability of patient education brochures generated by ChatGPT and Google Gemini without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
